messages:
Hannah: Posted postmortem for repeated KV eviction spikes. Link: https://notion.redwood/pm/kv-evictions-2024
IncidentBot: Postmortem created by Hannah. Please add remediation owners and timelines.
Diego: We need a concise triage checklist for the first 5 minutes + exact commands. Current runbook is vague.
Neha: I'll take the runbook rewrite. Aim: concrete checks, copy/paste cmds, and explicit escalation steps.
Priya: I'll own the safety gating rules for fallback (capacity & error-rate checks) and add PromQL.
Hannah: pasting quick commands to include in runbook:
```
# check memory/evictions
kubectl -n inference exec svc/cache-inspect -- redis-cli INFO memory | egrep 'used_memory|evicted_keys'
# cache hitrate (promql)
(sum(rate(cache_hits_total[1m])) by (svc)) / (sum(rate(cache_requests_total[1m])) by (svc))
# current fallback status
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://control.internal/api/v1/fallbacks | jq .current
```
Diego: add an explicit 'do not force fallback' note unless preflight passes (spare_capacity > 12% AND 1m error_rate < 0.5%). Otherwise escalate.
Priya: adding preflight prometheus queries and will create a Grafana panel link.
Neha: proposed escalation ladder in runbook: 1) page eng-oncall (pagerduty) 2) if no ack in 3m escalate to eng-sre 3) if error rate > 5% for 10m -> page infra-leads. Also include regional variant for APAC (shorter timers).
Hannah: owners/due dates: Runbook PR -> Neha (due 2024-08-02), Preflight + panel -> Priya (due 2024-07-30), Fallback wrapper script -> Diego (due 2024-07-31).
Diego: I'll implement a wrapper that acquires a lock and runs the preflight before issuing the fallback POST. Will test in staging.
Neha: adding a "what to expect" block for oncall (cold-pool latency spike, token-rate impact) and a rollback snippet for reverting fallbacks.
Priya: will validate the safety thresholds in staging and post test results here before the review.
Hannah: creating action items in tracker: https://go/repo/actions/33121. Please link PRs to that ticket.
IncidentBot: Follow-up check-in scheduled by Hannah for 2024-08-05 09:00 (calendar invite sent). Reminder 48h prior.
Neha: also adding a quarterly recurring audit task for cache playbooks with tag 'recurring-incidents'.
Diego: will open PR for wrapper + checklist by EOD today and tag reviewers.
Priya: will attach Grafana panel and PromQL to the runbook PR.
Hannah: great — target closing all remediation items within two sprints. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
